# Phase One — Main-Only Convergence

The goal is one canonical repository folder, one long-lived branch (`main`), and no valuable work stranded in auxiliary worktrees or historical branches.

## Non-negotiable constraints
- Mutate source only under `/Users/awtsmoos/work/awtsmoos.com`.
- Do not create any new branches.
- Preserve every valuable local commit and uncommitted file before deleting branch/worktree references.
- Never force-push over unknown remote work.
- Never commit secrets, caches, generated junk, or machine-local artifacts merely because they are untracked.
- Keep product source changes whole-file only.

## Convergence possibilities
- Detect branches already fully contained in `origin/main` and delete their local references after verifying no dirty worktree remains.
- Detect branches with unique commits and replay/merge their content into canonical `main` only after diff review and tests.
- Detect worktrees whose branch commit is already contained upstream but whose filesystem contains uncommitted changes; harvest those diffs into canonical `main` before removal.
- Detect prunable/missing worktrees and prune their metadata immediately after confirming their branch tips are safe.
- Preserve canonical `main`'s four unique commits.
- Classify the 2,009 canonical local changes by tracked/untracked, top-level area, size, and secret-risk before any commit.
- Bring `origin/main` into canonical `main` only after local work is made durable on `main`.
- Resolve conflicts in favor of current product truth rather than blindly taking one side.
- Run tests per merged area before publishing.
- Delete merged local branches and obsolete worktrees when their unique commit count against final `main` is zero.
